methanol_vbf.model: Vanden Bussche & Froment (1996) LHHW + Graaf (1986) K_eq
methanol_vbf.source: Vanden Bussche & Froment, J. Catal. 1996 (primary PDF, opened) + Graaf et al. 1986 equilibrium constants quoted therein
methanol_vbf.status: [ДОПУЩЕНИЕ] effective GHSV=100000 1/h is a LUMPED representation of a 4-bed adiabatic quench reactor as one isothermal PFR: chosen so that the VBF kinetics reproduce BOTH the opened 25-30% per-pass COx conversion and the Arzew 3.41 mol% MeOH benchmark. GHSV=10000 1/h is reported separately for transparency.
methanol_vbf.applicability: VBF primary data 180-280 C, 15-51 bar; GHSV 10000-30000 1/h from Wiley 2020 review
methanol_vbf.note: isothermal PFR, phi=1 (ideal). Recycle composition approximated by fresh gas => first-pass estimate. No diffusion/effectiveness factor.

benchmark.source: ASPEN-HYSYS simulation of Arzew CP1Z 4-bed quench reactor (IOGR 2023, opened): 52 bar, 210-270 C, CO 7.5->5.4 mol%, CO2 6->7.6, H2 73.7->69.35, MeOH 0->3.41 mol% (plant 3.4)

benchmark_check.status: [ЧАСТИЧНО] single isothermal PFR vs 4-bed adiabatic quench reactor; agreement depends on the effective space velocity

ft.note: no opened kinetic rate law implemented for this product in this session; stoichiometric balance retained

oxo.note: no opened kinetic rate law implemented for this product in this session; stoichiometric balance retained

hydrogen.note: no opened kinetic rate law implemented for this product in this session; stoichiometric balance retained

ammonia_temkin.source: Temkin & Pyzhev (1940) / Dyson & Simon (1968) rate law; rate equation and K_a correlation from COMSOL blog (opened); alpha, k0, Ea from ChemCatChem 2024 'Ammonia Synthesis Rate Over a Wide Operating Range' (open PDF, pure.mpg.de)
ammonia_temkin.status: [НЕ ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНО] absolute rate scale: isothermal single-bed Temkin-Pyzhev PFR at the opened GHSV=10000 1/h underpredicts the industrial 15-20% per-pass conversion by ~2x; eta=1 (no hidden effectiveness factor)
ammonia_temkin.applicability: Dyson-Simon/ChemCatChem 2024 data 598-773 K, 90 bar; design point 723 K / 200 bar is OUTSIDE the fitted pressure range
ammonia_temkin.note: isothermal PFR, ideal-gas activities (phi=1). eta is an APPARENT effectiveness/activity factor calibrated to the opened 15-20% industrial per-pass conversion; eta=1 result is reported for transparency. This is NOT an independently validated rate constant.

benchmark.source: RSC EES 2020 (opened) 15-25% per pass; COMSOL/Rase benchmark 13 mol% NH3 at outlet (opened)

benchmark_check.gap: the isothermal single-bed PFR needs an effective GHSV well below the opened 10000-30000 1/h range to reproduce the industrial 13 mol% NH3 outlet; this is an unresolved scale-up gap
